verdict.rationale: Postman validates live responses through post-response test scripts that can run in CI via the Postman CLI. The Playwright integration validates captured API calls against Postman Collections, which is the closest evidence to contract-drift detection. Spec Hub and governance checks only lint specifications, and nothing shows live responses being automatically checked against an API spec. Missing for 10: documented response-vs-OpenAPI/schema contract validation, explicit drift detection or alerting, independent hands-on corroboration.
